Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: The Planner introduced an unsupported claim that Andrew Bowler (Gigi Causey’s husband) graduated from USC in 1996, despite the WebSurfer having surfaced multiple credible indications of NYU’s Tisch School of the Arts (e.g., Wikipedia, a DiscDish interview noting “fellow alumnus of NYU Tisch,” and an NYU Tisch 1996 festival PDF). This misinterpretation/fabrication of a USC source contradicted stronger evidence, redirected the search down an incorrect path, and risked producing the wrong answer instead of the correct “Tisch.”
